name: Vikram Solar Ltd
about: Incorporated in 2005, Vikram Solar Ltd manufactures solar PV modules and also provides EPC and O&M services.[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
VSL is one of India’s largest pure-play solar 
photovoltaic module manufacturers in terms 
of operational capacity. The company also offers EPC & O&M services.

pros: Company has delivered good profit growth of 46.5% CAGR over last 5 years
cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Promoters have pledged or encumbered 48.2% of their holding.
Company's cost of borrowing seems high
Promoter holding has decreased over last 3 years: -30.0%
